notes.title: HyperCore Demo Update 0.99A - Gamescom 2024 Demo
notes.content:
[h1]HyperCore Demo 0.99A - Gamescom Demo[/h1]

[h2]The HyperCore Demo has been Updated.[/h2]

As I am showing the demo on Switch to gamescom, I updated the steam demo with all the new optimizations and features.

If you happen to be at gamescom, drop by the Indie Arena Booth, Hall 10.2, Booth F010g - E019

[h3]What's new :[/h3]

Campaign Prologue : Play a 3 levels introductory sequence to the full game's campaign !

Ranked Play : Ranked is now separate from the core levels. In this demo, you'll be able to play Voodoo Riot in Track mode in 3 different difficulties (Novice, Intermediate and the new Expert difficulty).

The demo is fully working with the steam deck.

Future update to the demo will feature different levels in different modes. the final difficulty, Master, will only be playable in the full game.

Pleas enjoy the game and do not hesitate to rech out on Discord or in the discussion forums for any feedback !

notes.title: HyperCore Demo Update 0.98B
notes.content:
[h1]HyperCore Demo 0.98B[/h1]

[h2]The HyperCore Demo has been Updated.[/h2]

[h3]The four currently playable levels are :[/h3]

Goodbye Planet (track) : Restore the biodata storage dashing through the cryostasis sector.
Voodoo Riot (Rail) : survive the bowels of the Tennenbaum Battle station.
Desolation (orbital): fight against the Thermal Regulator security Machine.
Skirmish (tube) : A glitch has corrupted Pris' databank ! Face this dangerous foe to stabilize her memories

[h3]Gameplay changes :[/h3]

Focus Chain : successfully alternate between focus mode and perfect dodges to increase your chain level and drastically increase your combo, but beware, failing to connect will break the full combo chain !

notes.title: HyperCore Demo Update 0.97e
notes.content:
[h1]HyperCore Demo 0.97a[/h1]

[h2]The HyperCore Demo has been Updated. [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35735645/3b78cc7e26847b1275f3d76687a2277c704804c1.gif[/img]

[h3]The two currently playable levels are : [/h3]

[list]
[*]HyperNova : Face an unstable star about to blow up
[*]Armada Core : fight against the very Core of the Tennenbaum Battle Station, featuring our new orbital style gameplay. 
[/list]

[h3]other fixes :[/h3]

-Fixed the resolution panel functionality.
-lowered the default volume to 70%.
-Fixed Gamepad/keyboard losing UI focus when alt-tabbing/using mouse.
-various framerate optimizations.
-added Sony Dualsense Compatibility.
